name: read-imap-codex-plugin
description: Read-only IMAP helper for reading recent registration and verification email bodies.

interface.shortDescription: Read recent registration email bodies from an IMAP inbox.
interface.longDescription: Provides read-only IMAP tools for reading recent registration and verification emails newest-first, including full parsed bodies and links so Codex can identify confirmation links and one-time codes. It does not accept commands from email and does not modify messages.
defaultPrompt: Find the latest registration code in my IMAP inbox.
Look for a confirmation link from this website.
